### 👋 About

**Senior Full Stack Engineer · Founder & CTO of [Cachin](https://cachin.app)** · 📍 Buenos Aires, Argentina

I build products end to end: web and mobile apps, the backend and database behind them, and the infrastructure that keeps them running. I work **AI-native** with Cursor, Claude Code and Codex.

### 🚀 What I'm building

| Project | What it is | Built with |
|---|---|---|
| 💸 **[Cachin](https://cachin.app)** 🔒 | LATAM QR payments on Solana, where I'm Founder & CTO. Payments app (iOS & Android), **CachinPOS** for merchants and a tap-to-pay **cold-wallet card**. Next up: **Visa card via a sponsored BIN**. | Expo · Privy passkeys · USDC · Solana Pay |
| 🤖 **[Walter-OS](https://github.com/kevan1/walter-os)** | Open-source, self-hostable AI agent harness that runs Claude Code, Codex and Cursor under one contract, with approval gates. Co-built with [Nico Fernandez](https://github.com/f0x1777). | Skills · MCP · default-deny egress |
| ⏱️ **[Horas](https://github.com/kevan1/horas)** | Chat-first time tracking (iOS & Android). Gemini drafts the entries, people confirm them. | Expo · Supabase · Gemini · pgTAP |
| 🥩 **[STEAK.NET](https://github.com/kevan1/steak-net)** · [live](https://steak.net) | Liquid staking on Solana: swap SOL or any LST into STEAKSOL with best-route quotes. | Next.js · Sanctum · Jupiter |
| 🛡️ **[Guards](https://github.com/kevan1/guards-ui)** · [live](https://guards-ui.vercel.app) | Treasury risk dashboard on Pyth price, EMA and confidence data, built with Nico Fernandez at Pythathon. | Next.js · Pyth |
| 🌐 **[kevan.ar](https://github.com/kevan1/kevan.ar)** · [live](https://kevan.ar) | My portfolio, with a RAG chatbot over the site content. | Next.js · MDX · LangChain · OpenAI |
| 🕵️ **[Midnight ZK-KYC](https://github.com/kevan1/midnight-zk-kyc)** | Privacy-preserving KYC: prove age, country and liveness with zero-knowledge proofs. | Next.js · Midnight SDK |
| 🧰 **[dotfiles](https://github.com/kevan1/dotfiles)** · [mac playbook](https://github.com/kevan1/kevan-setup-mac-playbook) | My workstation as code. | zsh · Ansible |
